court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Smt. Sunita v. Shri Ramesh — full case name
facts_of_case: The parties were married under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The wife claimed that her husband had deserted her and sought divorce. The trial court allowed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if there has been no reasonable cohabitation between the parties for a period of at least one year.
legal_principles.held: It is held that a petition for divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if there has been no reasonable cohabitation between the parties for a period of at least one year.
use_in: divorce cases under Hindu Marriage Act

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that there has been no reasonable cohabitation between the parties for a period of at least one year.
legal_principles.held: It is held that the burden lies on the petitioner to prove that there has been no reasonable cohabitation between the parties for a period of at least one year.
use_in: divorce cases under Hindu Marriage Act

outcome.final_order: The final order was that the appeal was dismissed and the decree of divorce passed by the trial court was confirmed.
